correctness.rationale: Preserving all chosen existential witnesses, there are at most 2^k orientation profiles for remaining vertices. A model of size greater than k+(R_dir(ell)-1)2^k therefore contains a transitive ell-vertex tournament of one profile. Every assignment to at most ell universally quantified variables in a larger cloned transitive block has an equality- and arc-preserving injection into that block, preserving the quantifier-free matrix and yielding all orders n>=k+ell. Sharpness uses an R_dir(ell)-1-vertex transitive-ell-free tournament copied to every one of 2^k profiles, with a universal prohibition of ell distinct nonwitness profile-mates inducing a transitive tournament. This condition is quantifier-free after ell universals and finite conjunction/disjunction. Cases k=0 and ell=2 are included. Independent enumeration of 64 labeled four-vertex tournaments shows a transitive triple, and a three-cycle supplies R_dir(3)>=4. These finite checks only calibrate ell=3.
